name: rag_knowledge_produce
question: >-
  Implement the missing producer edge of the async knowledge spine: the code that turns a measured
  run result into a KnowledgeRecord + a pointer-only KnowledgeEvent and emits it into the change
  stream (kb:v1:changes), so the consumers (kb-chroma-v1 / kb-neo4j-v1 / kb-ledger-v1) have
  something to drain. Then run it once against the current measured corpus to give the spine its
  first heartbeat. The retrieval/constructor/identity core and the consumer side already exist on
  main; only the producer is missing.
version: "0.1"
workflow:
  kind: agent_task
  params:
    language: python
    fork: true
    context:
      brief: >-
        This completes the async spine end-to-end. The consumer side (knowledge_stream.py +
        scripts/kb_worker.py) is built and on main; retrieval/constructor/identity are built. The
        producer is the missing edge: measured result -> KnowledgeRecord -> KnowledgeEvent -> stream.
